title: Bounds for the Zeros of Quaternionic Polynomials via Matrix Methods
summary: In this paper, we derive new bounds for the zeros of quaternionic polynomials by applying localization theorems, which includes Gershgorin-type theorems for the left eigenvalues of matrices of left monic quaternionic polynomials. These results yield sharper estimates compared to existing bounds, including improvements upon Cauchy, Fujiwara and Opfer's classical bounds. Second, we develop a matrix norm approach utilizing block matrix techniques and spectral norm estimates for a specially constructed auxiliary poly nomial.
